svg.title: Thirty-two things, weighted by how current. Languages: Python (daily), TypeScript (daily), JavaScript (daily), C (regular), Java (regular), SQL (regular), C# (familiar), PHP (familiar), R (familiar). Vision & ML: PyTorch (daily), OpenCV (daily), SIFT (daily), scikit-learn (regular), Transformers (regular), segmentation (regular), TensorFlow (familiar). Web: React (daily), Django (daily), Node.js (regular), Next.js (regular), React Native (regular), Express (regular), Flask (familiar). Data: PostgreSQL (daily), MongoDB (regular), MySQL (regular), SQLite (familiar). Tools: Git (daily), Unix/Linux (daily), Docker (regular), Playwright (regular), Unity (familiar).
